derivation:
by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply 𝒪 (chartVRing 𝒪 r) (Avn 𝒪 r π n), Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, ← map_pow]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_singleton_self _
explanation: Avn is the quotient by the ideal generated by (algebraMap 𝒪 (chartVRing 𝒪 r) π)^(n+1). The Mathlib lemma says that a principal ideal's generator vanishes in its quotient; instantiate it with this power.
